name: Isskogelstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Isskogelstüberl in Gerlos!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, the **Isskogelstüberl** invites you to a cozy mountain retreat with breathtaking views of the **Hohe Munde** and the **Ahornspitze**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this rustic alpine hut offers a perfect escape into nature.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and **Schlutzkrapfen**, all made with fresh, local ingredients. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler** beer or a warming shot of **Schnaps**—traditional **Tiroler** hospitality at its finest.

After your meal, take a stroll along the well-marked trails leading to the **Isskogel** summit, where panoramic vistas of the **Ötztal Alps** await. In winter, enjoy snowshoeing or cross-country skiing right from the hut.

Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, the **Isskogelstüberl** promises an unforgettable experience in the wild beauty of **Tirol**.
